name: net19
description: Prepare historical website styles before opening pages. Adjustable year, automatic archive lookup and a local cache.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; connect-src https://archive.org https://web.archive.org; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'self'
